blocks.text: 枉費青春用我的夢 沒法度得到我心愛的人
blocks.spelling: óng huì tshing-tshun iōng guá ê bāng bô-huat tōo tio̍h guá sim ài ê lâng

blocks.text: 枉費青春用我的希望 浪費我一世人
blocks.spelling: óng huì tshing-tshun iōng guá ê hi-bāng lōng-huì guá tsi̍t-sì-lâng

blocks.text: 唉….妳在說啥貨 心肝對我安呢甘會得過
blocks.spelling: haih…. lí leh kóng siánn-huè sim-kuann tuì guá an neh kam ē tit kuè

blocks.text: 枉費青春為妳一人 沒法度相信我目眶紅
blocks.spelling: óng huì tshing-tshun uî lí tsi̍t lâng bô-huat tōo siong-sìn guá ba̍k-khoo âng

blocks.text: 如何麥想伊 如何麥提起
blocks.spelling: jû-hô mái sióng i jû-hô mái thê-khí

blocks.text: 安怎這狼狽 情債算未利
blocks.spelling: an-tsuánn tsia liông-puē tsîng-tsè sǹg bē lī

blocks.text: 難道這是因為妳來看我未起
blocks.spelling: kám-kóng tse sī in-uī lī lâi khuànn guá bē khí

blocks.text: 我的心愛 我的心愛
blocks.spelling: guá ê tshin-ài guá ê tshin-ài
